title: Steubenville High School and its band
summary: Howard says he graduated from Steubenville High School, where he played tenor sax in the school band.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: And you were working at Bullock's, and you were studying music and, I guess, going to school, or--?
Yeah, go to school, too.
What--?
(chuckle) what going to school?
You're doing that all at once, and==?
Yeah, my father done raised me to
go to school.
Well, had you finished high school before you came out here? Or did you finish here in Los Angeles?
I finished here in Los Angeles.
What high school did you go to?
Let's see. If I can think of that, now, I'll have it made.
Okay.
(chuckle)
If I can think of what the name of the school was Steubenville (phonetic) High School. Steubenville Stupidsville High School.
Steubenville Stupidsville High School.
So you graduated before you came out here?
Yeah, I graduated before I--(laughter)
I saw a reference in this article-- (laughter).Okay.
Yeah.
That's what I played-- Steubenville High School.
Did they have a band in your high school?
Yeah, we had a band.
You played in the school band?
Yep, I played in the school band (laughter), Steubenville High School.
You played in three or four bands at Steubenville, didn't you? You played in the one with your brother, and you played in the one, the classical one, and you played in the park with the older people?
Yep.
And you played in the school band?

Why I got in the school band was --I got in the band when I got that tenor, tenor saxophone. That's when I got in there. And the band (inaudible) --the school people. My people They made me go to school, my bills people.
That's good, isn't it?
Huh? Oh, yeah, I'm glad they made me go to school. (chuckle) I really learned a lot'a things.
Were there any other saxophones in the school band?
Uh-uh. No, there wand't. And I wish I could go to school again tomorrow. I really do.
Go again?
Wish I could go to school again tomorrow.
